name: eeaimod-texts
description: The eeaimod text files (.eeai): personalities, mod/computer.eeai, mod/prompt.eeai, mod/system.eeai - records, keys, strings, placeholders, expressions - and the setup scripts (tests/scenarios, tests/probes): statements, functions, commands. Highlighting, the mistakes shown as they are typed, completion and hover, go to definition and find all uses (ageofai_check --lsp)

eeai.checker.description: ageofai_check.exe for the checks while typing - empty: the one in a folder above the file (the game folder), else the workspace's dll\ageofai_check.exe
